hero.name: Kotaro Otake

about.title: About
about.description: Studied AI and Brain-Computer Interface at university, researching AI-based augmentation of brainwave data. Started taking on logistics center DX contracts as a student. Now a multi-domain DX engineer, simultaneously driving core system renewal and on-site care DX at a care company, publishing DX as a contractor, and running my own solo business — all powered by AI.
